raw_response:
Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) demonstrates a small, hypoplastic right lung with diffuse opacity and ipsilateral mediastinal shift (dextroposition of the heart), which are hallmark features of Scimitar syndrome; the CT images confirm the anomalous venous drainage. Option B is the only choice that correctly identifies the right-sided pathology and mediastinal shift associated with this congenital anomaly.
